sections.h2: China supplies 73.71% of India's API imports, far ahead of any other origin

chart.title: No other single country exceeds 2.5% of the import bill
chart.sub: Share of India's API, bulk-drug and intermediate imports by origin, FY2024-25, %.

sections.means: China's share sits near its FY23 peak, so five years of PLI have not visibly reduced it.
sections.todo: Set an explicit target percentage and year for closing the China gap, since no PIB document states one.

sections.h2: Imports avoided rose each snapshot, reaching 2,192 crore by December 2025

chart.title: Cumulative imports avoided climbed from 1,483 to 2,192 crore in six months
chart.sub: Cumulative imports avoided under PLI-Bulk Drugs, crore.
chart.source: PIB and Department of Pharmaceuticals releases, June to December 2025.

sections.means: Imports avoided remain small beside the 6,940 crore outlay, even though the figure is rising.
sections.todo: Publish a newer imports-avoided figure, since none later than December 2025 was found.
